rows.summary: ONON's operating margin expanded from 11.1% (Q4 2025) to 14.1% (Q1 2026) — a 300bps improvement in a single quarter. Net margin rose from 9.3% to 12.4%. Operating income grew 46.6% sequentially ($81.9M to $120M) on just 15.2% sequential revenue growth, demonstrating powerful operating leverage as the brand scales.
rows.what_changed: Operating margins have inflected sharply higher from the ~11% range to ~14%, suggesting the brand has reached a scale inflection point where fixed costs are being absorbed more efficiently.
rows.why_now: The Q1 2026 financials show a step-change in profitability that goes beyond the broader 'financial quality improving' signal — this is a specific, measurable acceleration in operating leverage.

rows.summary: ONON trades at $36.83, below all key moving averages (SMA20 $37.21, SMA50 $37.03, SMA200 $41.23) with RSI at 40.3 (oversold), yet just delivered a massive 39.6% EPS beat ($0.47 vs $0.34 est) with strong sequential revenue growth from $738M to $850M. rows.why_now: The Q1 2026 earnings beat of 39.6% combined with the stock trading below its 200-day SMA by ~12% reveals a stark disconnect between price action and fundamental performance.
